# CallSense

> CallSense uses AI to check every sales and customer call a business's team makes, in 50+ languages, and shows which leads were never called back, why people didn't buy, and who on the team sells best. Results go into a live dashboard with daily alerts, and owners can ask ChatGPT or Claude about their calls. Built for Indian businesses and usable worldwide. It starts with a missed-lead report on the last 30 days of calls, delivered 48 hours after connecting; the business keeps the report either way and can continue on a monthly plan, cancelling any time.

## What we deliver

- Every call transcribed automatically after it ends, from the business's calling system (Superfone, Exotel, MyOperator, Knowlarity, Aircall, RingCentral and most systems that record calls).
- Mood and intent labels for each call (for example keen, unsure, angry, just browsing), with the reason.
- Key details pulled out of every call into the same fields, chosen with the business: budget, product or course, appointment, order, objection, next step.
- A live dashboard: calls by agent, outcomes, lost reasons, follow-ups due.
- Alerts (for example a hot lead not called back in 24 hours) and a weekly owner report.
- A private, read-only connection so owners can ask ChatGPT or Claude about their calls in plain language.
- Customisation: fields, mood and lead labels, call-scoring checklist, objections and competitors to watch, alerts, languages.

## Languages

Hindi, English, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Arabic, Spanish and 50+ more, including calls that switch languages. Tested on a few of the business's own calls before starting. Reports come back in English.

## Who it is for

Any business that talks to customers on the phone, for example:

- Real estate: leads never called back
- Coaching & edtech: parents not followed up
- D2C & e-commerce: why cod orders cancel
- Clinics & hospitals: appointments not booked
- Insurance: policies not closed
- Loans & NBFCs: applications dropped
- Car & bike dealers: test drives not booked
- Travel & tours: enquiries gone cold
- B2B & manufacturing: quotes not chased
- Solar & home services: site visits missed
- Interiors & furniture: quotes never followed up
- Hotels & banquets: bookings lost
- Schools & colleges: admissions missed
- Recruitment & staffing: candidates dropped
- Gyms & salons: trials not converted
- Software & SaaS: demos not booked

## Privacy

Each business's calls are kept in their own private database, sent over encrypted connections, seen only by people the business approves, never sold and never used to train AI models, and deleted on request. Handled in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP) and, for customers in Europe, GDPR.
